purpose: Final-wave fill for base god books (Fremennik Horror from the Deep) and Archaeology luck ladder permanents still missing from data/research/regional-skilling-unlocks.json: fremennik:god-books-horror-from-the-deep, cross-region:luck-of-the-dwarves, cross-region:ring-of-wealth-relic, cross-region:ring-of-fortune-relic. Illuminated path already first-class as desert:citharede-abbey-illuminated-books — not re-emitted.

policy.region_rule: region_hint is primary geography. region_hints lists support pressure. required_regions only when every listed region is a hard gate. Never put multi-region/cross-region/global tokens in region_hint.
policy.duplicate_guard: Grep-confirmed absent from regional-skilling-unlocks.json for all 4 target ids. SKIP already first-class: desert:citharede-abbey-illuminated-books (illumination only; correctly notes base books from Horror from the Deep). Do not re-emit illuminated path.
policy.luck_ladder_rule: Ring of Fortune and Ring of Wealth relic powers are permanent Archaeology monolith luck-ladder rungs (tier 3 / tier 2). Emit only as monolith permanent unlocks — not as wear-slot gear rows. Luck of the Dwarves covers both the craftable tier-4 ring (teleports + wear luck) and the top Hand of Glory → monolith relic (passive tier-4 luck, no teleports).
policy.no_trade_rule: Ironman permanent pocket-slot god-book completion and permanent luck-relic ladder that free the ring slot while keeping rare-table / Archaeology QoL.
policy.rate_rule: No invented drop rates beyond wiki luck-tier summaries. Unlock state, costs, energy, and effects only.

skipped_present.reason: Illuminated upgrade path already first-class under Desert; this pack owns base damaged-book + page completion under Fremennik only.

activity_additions.name: God books base unlock (Horror from the Deep)
activity_additions.location: Lighthouse (north of Barbarian Outpost / Fremennik coast) — Jossik after Horror from the Deep
requirements: Horror from the Deep completed (Bar Crawl miniquest; 35 Agility for quest path)
Choose a damaged god book from Jossik (Saradomin / Guthix / Zamorak free at quest end; Bandos / Armadyl / Ancient purchasable for 5,000 coins each after first book — Ancient also needs The Dig Site)
Four matching god pages per book to complete (Treasure Trails, Columbarium vyre cremation, tetracompasses, or trade)
30 Prayer to equip a completed god book (40 Prayer for illuminated after Citharede path)
unlocks: Damaged god books reclaimable free from Jossik at the Lighthouse (one book per visit; order Saradomin → Guthix → Zamorak → Bandos → Armadyl → Zaros, or buy specific via menu once unlocked)
Completed god books (Law, War, Balance, Wisdom, Chaos, Ancient) in the pocket slot with combat passive effects when charged with matching pages (45 minutes per page, max 24 hours / 32 pages)
GWD faction protection from Armadyl / Bandos / Saradomin / Zamorak books (Guthix and Ancient provide no faction protection)
POH bookcase reclaim of completed books for 100,000 coins if lost
Prerequisite permanent for desert:citharede-abbey-illuminated-books (illumination creates a separate illuminated copy; base book is preserved)
region_pressure: Fremennik hard-owns Lighthouse quest end and Jossik damaged-book reclaim.
God-page supply is multi-region (clues, Morytania Columbarium, Archaeology tetracompasses) — not Fremennik-only.
Illumination is Desert-only (Citharede) — do not dual-claim here.
activity_additions.notes: Base god-book permanent complementary to desert:citharede-abbey-illuminated-books. Wave-5 audit rank 5: illumination row already notes base books come from Horror from the Deep but never first-classed the Fremennik gate. Scriptures / Erethdor / chaotic grimoire are separate pocket items — out of scope.
activity_additions.league_treatment: Hard Fremennik for quest reward and Lighthouse reclaim. Page farming and illumination remain multi-region / Desert pressure.

activity_additions.name: Ring of Wealth (relic power)
activity_additions.location: Mysterious monolith, Archaeology Campus (Varrock Dig Site)
requirements: Hand of Glory (Ring of Luck) already created at some point (tier-1 ladder prereq)
Any unused hand of glory (Infernal Source 24 / Everlight 51 / Kharid-et 58 / Warforge 83) + fully charged Ring of Wealth → Hand of Glory (Ring of Wealth)
2,000 chronotes and 100 monolith energy to harness
unlocks: Ring of Wealth relic power — always gain tier 2 luck while harnessed (frees the ring slot)
Tier 2 rare-drop / skilling luck ladder (mid bosses, Barrows pieces at T2+, Pyramid Plunder jewelled statuettes / Pharaoh's sceptre, Rogue outfit, easy–medium clues, crystal chest / Triskelion +1%)
Does not grant Ring of Wealth teleports
Required permanent rung before Ring of Fortune and Luck of the Dwarves relic powers
region_pressure: Misthalin hard-owns monolith harness and Archaeology campus reclaim (Easty).
Hands of glory are multi dig-site (Forinthry Infernal Source, Morytania Everlight, Desert Kharid-et, Kandarin Warforge) — any unused hand works.
Physical Ring of Wealth is craft/enchant supply pressure, not a region hard gate.
activity_additions.notes: Permanent Archaeology luck ladder tier 2. Intermediate rung only — end state for planners is usually cross-region:luck-of-the-dwarves. Complements misthalin:mysterious-monolith-relic-hub without re-emitting it.
activity_additions.league_treatment: Misthalin for monolith. Dig-site hands are optional multi-region pressure (player may use any of the four hands).

activity_additions.name: Ring of Fortune (relic power)
activity_additions.location: Mysterious monolith, Archaeology Campus (Varrock Dig Site)
requirements: Hand of Glory (Ring of Luck) and Hand of Glory (Ring of Wealth) already created (prior ladder rungs)
Any remaining unused hand of glory + Ring of Fortune → Hand of Glory (Ring of Fortune)
3,000 chronotes and 150 monolith energy to harness
unlocks: Ring of Fortune relic power — always gain tier 3 luck while harnessed

Tier 3 rare-drop / skilling luck (broader boss list, all Slayer uniques +1%, Pyramid Plunder black ibis / Sceptre of the gods, Menaphite offerings, tetracompass pieces / complete tomes while excavating, hard clues, crystal chest / Triskelion +2%)
Does not grant Ring of Fortune teleports
Required permanent rung before Luck of the Dwarves relic power
region_pressure: Typical hand for this rung is Kharid-et (58 Archaeology Orcus altar; needs pontifex signet ring) — Desert optional pressure, not exclusive.
Physical Ring of Fortune is hydrix enchant supply pressure.
activity_additions.notes: Permanent Archaeology luck ladder tier 3. Skilling-relevant tetracompass / complete-tome excavating boost starts at this tier (shared with LotD). Pair with cross-region:luck-of-the-dwarves as the planner end rung.
activity_additions.league_treatment: Misthalin for monolith. Hands remain multi dig-site optional pressure.

activity_additions.name: Luck of the Dwarves (ring + Archaeology relic power)
activity_additions.category: permanent luck enhancer and Archaeology monolith relic power
activity_additions.location: Craft/enchant anywhere; relic harness at mysterious monolith (Archaeology Campus). Physical ring teleports: Miscellania, Grand Exchange, Keldagrim (+ Dwarven Outpost with Dark Facet of Luck)
requirements: 91 Crafting + alchemical onyx + gold bar + ring mould → alchemical onyx ring; 87 Magic Lvl-6 Enchant → Luck of the Dwarves (or GE / trade path)
For relic power: prior Hand of Glory (Ring of Luck / Wealth / Fortune) rungs completed; any remaining unused hand of glory + Luck of the Dwarves ring → Hand of Glory (Luck of the Dwarves)
83 Archaeology (boostable) to harness the relic; 4,000 chronotes and 200 monolith energy
Optional: Dark Facet of Luck on the physical ring for clue-step skip / double casket / Dwarven Outpost tele (does not transfer to the relic power)
unlocks: Physical Luck of the Dwarves: tier 4 luck while worn (includes T1–T3 effects) plus unlimited teleports to Miscellania (Throne of Miscellania), Grand Exchange, and Keldagrim
Luck of the Dwarves relic power: always gain tier 4 luck while harnessed without occupying the ring slot

Tier 4 skilling QoL: improved tetracompass piece / complete tome chance while excavating; +2% metamorphic geode; Pyramid Plunder / Menaphite offerings / Seren's symbol pieces; rare drop table access including Vecna skull and Hazelmere's signet ring rolls; removes flax / raw lobsters / molten glass from RDT
Relic power does NOT grant the ring's teleports — keep a second physical ring (or accept tele loss) if teleports matter
Imbue at Mazcab Armoursmith (7,500 teci) is combat-stat only on the physical ring
region_pressure: Misthalin: monolith harness + Grand Exchange teleport destination.
Fremennik optional: Miscellania tele (Throne of Miscellania) and Keldagrim access lore; not required to harness the relic.
Kandarin optional: Warforge hand of glory (highest-level hand often used for the top rung).
Hands of glory also available from Infernal Source / Everlight / Kharid-et.
activity_additions.notes: Wave-5 audit rank 6 ironman Archaeology rare-table QoL staple. Models both the craftable wear-slot ring and the permanent Hand of Glory → monolith top luck rung. Relic consumes the ring irreversibly — planners often delay until a second LotD is affordable. Does not re-emit intermediate wealth/fortune rungs (see sibling ids in this pack).
activity_additions.league_treatment: Misthalin for monolith. Physical ring teleports and dig-site hands are optional multi-region pressure, not dual-hard gates for the relic unlock itself.
